editorial:
Imagine your cousin is a total disaster and suddenly disappears without a trace. That is exactly what Alex deals with when her cousin Carolyn goes missing. You quickly find out that Carolyn was working as a webcam girl, which is a risky business. Alex has a gut feeling that Carolyn met one of her online clients in real life and something went wrong. The problem is that nobody believes her, and the police aren't helping much. It feels like a race against time as Alex tries to dig through the dark corners of the internet to find the predator who took her cousin. It is a tense setup that makes you feel the urgency of the situation from the very start.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who the bad guy actually is. The acting feels natural, and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While it is a TV movie and doesn't have a huge budget, the suspense makes up for it. If you enjoy mysteries where one person has to solve everything on their own, you will love this. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you like keeping movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a solid pick for a weekend binge.
endingExplained: In the final act, you discover that the predator is someone who used the webcam sites to hunt and trap women. Alex manages to track down where Carolyn is being held. After a scary confrontation, Alex saves her cousin just in time. The movie wraps up with the kidnapper getting caught by the police, showing that Alex's instincts were right all along. It ends on a relief-filled note with the two cousins safe and sound.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves missing person mysteries and digital crime stories.
